reason: The immediate goal is to put the station on reserve, so I’ll use the charged reserve at the service panel.
expectation: I expect the panel to switch essential systems to reserve power, though I may still need to stop industrial loads separately.

alternatives.reason: Stopping the return plant also fits the storm warning, but switching to reserve addresses the current goal directly.

effect: Essential systems are on reserve and production has stopped; the exterior circuits still need to be made safe.
reaction: The distinction between stopping production and keeping shutdown controls powered makes sense.
reason: I’ll address the running return plant at the panel to secure an exterior industrial circuit.
expectation: I expect a controlled shutdown or isolation of the return plant, though the panel may require further steps.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs attention, but I’ll secure the industrial plant first.

effect: The return plant is isolated, with some propellant lost to boil-off; the water line remains to be secured.
reaction: The controlled cooldown and separate vents make the storm preparation feel physically grounded.
reason: The water line is the only remaining gameplay action and should address the exterior circuits goal.
expectation: I expect the panel to put the water line into a safe state for the storm, though I don't know exactly how.

effect: The well is isolated and the exterior hose is drained before its heating switches off, completing the storm preparations.
reaction: The order of draining before switching off heat is a clear, sensible detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Securing the return plant was most worthwhile: the controlled cooldown, separate vents and recoverable boil-off made the consequences of the storm tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Switching to reserve was straightforward and mostly confirmed the immediate goal, though the powered shutdown sequence was useful context.

surprise.text: The cold tanks retain some liquid but lose some to boil-off during the shutdown; the plant can replace it afterward.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary. The water-line action was the only remaining gameplay option, but draining it before disabling heat gave it a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. The storm preparations were brief but physically grounded, and I would be curious to see what happens after the interruption.
